usedFor: Woodpecker runs outreach emails and Eden AI writes with AI models, so “Prospect Interested” can start “Create Chat Conversation”.

bestTemplate.name: “Prospect Interested” in Woodpecker, then “Create Chat Conversation” in Eden AI
bestTemplate.why: An interested prospect is the cue to draft a reply, and the model’s answer comes back to review.

watchOut: “Email Opened” also triggers it, so use the narrower “Prospect Interested” unless you want a run on every open.
